**These methods restrict adaptation in different places.** LoRA changes effective linear weights through a low-rank update. DoRA separates weight magnitude and direction, adapting directional structure with a low-rank mechanism while treating magnitude separately. Prefix tuning learns additional attention-context vectors. Bottleneck adapters insert small trainable modules into the network. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09353) [3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00190)

**A geometric analogy.** LoRA adds a restricted set of directions to a transformation. DoRA explicitly distinguishes how far a weight vector points from which direction it points. Prefix tuning changes the learned context the model attends to, while inserted adapters provide an extra transformation along the computation path. These are related parameter-efficient approaches, not interchangeable file formats.

**Serving consequences differ.** A suitable LoRA update can be merged into a dense weight for inference, though quantized-base details require care. Prefix methods add attention-state/context overhead. Inserted adapters add operations unless a particular structure permits fusion. DoRA's deployment behavior depends on how its decomposition is materialized.

Choose using held-out quality, trainable parameter count, memory, latency, and how many task variants must coexist. A system serving many adapters over one shared base may value easy switching more than the lowest single-adapter latency.

Compare matched data and tuning effort. “Fewer trainable parameters” does not mean “less total memory” in every configuration, and a more expressive adaptation can still overfit poor data. Verify compatibility with the actual base model, projection layout, and inference runtime before treating a research method as a drop-in production option.

**Technical details and references.**

LoRA learns an additive low-rank matrix update; it can usually be merged into a compatible dense weight for inference. DoRA separates weight magnitude from direction, applying low-rank adaptation to the direction with a separately learned magnitude. Prefix tuning learns continuous prefix states that attention can consult. Bottleneck adapters insert trainable down-projection, nonlinearity, and up-projection modules between frozen layers. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09353) [3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00190)

$$\Delta W_{LoRA}=BA,\qquad W_{DoRA}=m\frac{W_0+BA}{\|W_0+BA\|}\ \text{along the chosen weight axis}.$$

Prefix tuning increases attention/cache work; unmerged adapters add computation; merged LoRA avoids its extra matrix operations but requires storing or materializing a merged model. Compare trainable parameter count, activation memory, task quality, switching latency, and multi-adapter serving—not just checkpoint size.
